inputs.folder: One bounded pool of readers for the whole tree instead of re-checking every parent folder per file, which took 26% of load time. Cost: gains are uneven; a 5,000-request folder opened in 3.1 to 12.9 s across six runs.
run.pre: A fresh goja runtime per script instead of a shared one, because imported Postman and Bruno scripts are untrusted. Cost: one runtime per script made 400 scripts take 3.6 s, until up to four pre-booted spares cut it to 2.0 s.
